being confident of this very thing
that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
For I am certain of this very thing
that he by whom the good work was started in you will make it complete till the day of Jesus Christ:
你从水中经过，我必与你同在；
你趟过江河，水必不漫过你；
你从火中行过，必不被烧，
火焰也不着在你身上。
When you pass through the waters
I will be with you; and through the rivers
they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire
you will not be burned
and flame will not scorch you.

they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire
you will not be burned
and flame will not scorch you.
When you go through the waters
I will be with you; and through the rivers
they will not go over you: when you go through the fire
you will not be burned; and the flame will have no power over you.

brothers

holy

brothers

holy

brothers
by the mercies of God
that you will give your bodies as a living offering
holy
pleasing to God

love

love

Having our eyes fixed on Jesus
the guide and end of our faith
who went through the pains of the cross
not caring for the shame
because of the joy which was before him
and who has now taken his place at the right hand of God's seat of power.

“Ask
and it will be given you. Seek
and you will find. Knock
and it will be opened for you.
Make a request
and it will be answered; what you are searching for you will get; give the sign
and the door will be open to you:
我的帮助从造天地的耶和华而来。
My help comes from Yahweh
who made heaven and earth.

My help comes from Yahweh
who made heaven and earth.
Your help comes from the Lord
who made heaven and earth.
你们要思念上面的事，
不要思念地上的事。
Set your mind on the things that are above
not on the things that are on the earth.

不要思念地上的事。

not on the things that are on the earth.
Keep your mind on the higher things

not forsaking our own assembling together
